description:
The Ultimate Ride for Families on the Go

Turn every errand, park visit, or neighborhood cruise into a family adventure with the all-new EVRYjourney Family Cargo E-Trike from sixthreezero. Designed for parents who want freedom, fun, and functionality, this e-trike is more than just a ride—it’s a rolling experience for the whole crew.

Built for Family Adventures

The spacious front cargo box can comfortably seat up to four little passengers with padded bench seating and individual harnesses for safety. Toddlers, preschoolers, and early elementary kids (recommended ages 2–8) can ride along in comfort, while the easy-access side door lets them hop in and out without a struggle.

Up to 4 children under age 4 can fit, or 2–3 older kids depending on size.

Cozy, padded seats with back support and harnesses keep every rider secure.

Parents stay connected up front while kids enjoy the ride with the best view in town.

Power Meets Peace of Mind

Equipped with a 1000w rear-mounted motor, this trike has the muscle to move your family smoothly through city streets, bike paths, and neighborhood hills. Paired with a 21Ah battery, you’ll enjoy up to 50 miles of range—plenty for school drop-offs, grocery runs, or a full day of park hopping.

Top speed: 16mph (safe yet swift for family rides).

Hydraulic disc brakes deliver confident stopping power, even when fully loaded.

4-inch wide tires create a stable base, so you always feel in control.

Comfort and Control

Parents will appreciate the straight bar handlebar with foam padding for all-day comfort, and the unique rotating cargo steering system that makes this larger trike surprisingly nimble. The 20" x 4" front wheels and 24" x 4" rear wheel balance stability with smooth maneuverability, so you can handle tight turns around the neighborhood with ease.

Why Families Love It

Neighborhood Cruises: Perfect for school pickups, park trips, and weekend ice cream runs.

Eco-Friendly Alternative: Ditch short car trips and enjoy pedal-assist fun.

Shared Experience: Kids love the adventure up front, and parents love the freedom to ride together.

The EVRYjourney Family Cargo E-Trike isn’t just another bike—it’s your family’s new favorite way to move, explore, and make memories.
